Name: Torishiki
Hours: 17:00–23:00 (last entry 21:00); closed Sundays and Mondays
Address (JA): 東京都品川区上大崎2-14-12
Notes: Omakase-only, 12-seat counter where chef Yoshiteru Ikegawa grills free-range Date chicken from Fukushima. Michelin star since 2010; Tabelog Yakitori EAST 100 2025. Very hard to book: seats open two months out, and Time Out suggests calling on the first service day of each month. Update: Address is in Shinagawa ward (Kami-Osaki), a 2-minute walk from Meguro Station east exit. Retty lists different hours (18:00–21:00), so confirm by phone, 03-3440-7656.

Name: Yakitori Abe
Hours: 17:00–23:00 (last entry 21:30); Ikyu lists no closed day, but the Info line says closed Sundays
Address (JA): 東京都品川区上大崎3-3-4 MIYUKI HOUSE 1F
Notes: Sister of Torishiki, with Date chicken over Kishu binchotan and about 60 wines; Michelin Bib Gourmand, Tabelog Yakitori EAST 100 2025. The easier way into the Torishiki style; dinner about ¥6,000. Closed Sundays. Update: Address is in Shinagawa ward (Kami-Osaki), 4 minutes on foot from Meguro Station. Phone 03-5422-9834.

Name: BIRD LAND
Hours: 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Sundays, Mondays and holidays (OpenTable shows Tue–Sat 17:00–21:30)
Address (JA): 東京都中央区銀座4-2-15 塚本素山ビルB1
Notes: Michelin calls it a pioneer of course-style yakitori; known for liver pâté, oyakodon and rare cuts. Tabelog Yakitori EAST 100 2025. Bookable on OpenTable, which is easy for visitors.

Name: Toranomon Yakitori Kuniyoshi
Hours: 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Sundays and holidays per one source (another lists Sat/Sun closed)
Address (JA): ~東京都港区虎ノ門一丁目
Notes: #1 on Tabelog Yakitori EAST 100 2025 (3.69); set course ¥14,800 plus 10% service. Online booking only; closed Sundays and holidays. Update: Basement unit near 西新橋2丁目 交差点, about 5 min from Toranomon Station; exact address not retrieved. Phone 03-3581-1988. Only the 2024 Tabelog Yakitori EAST 100 selection was confirmed, not 2025. Basement of Shinwa Building near Nishi-Shimbashi 2-chome-nishi crossing; no street number found. Location approximate: pinned near 虎ノ門 station until the shop is found.

Name: Yakitori Imai
Hours: Gurunavi: Mon–Fri 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00). Time Out: 17:30–22:30, closed Sat and Sun (may be dated).
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区神宮前3-42-11 ローザビアンカ1F
Notes: Counter yakitori using Tamba jidori, Akadori and Okukuji shamo, with natural wines; Michelin Bib Gourmand, Tabelog EAST 100 2025. Dinner about ¥8,000; closed Sundays. Update: Sources say closed Saturdays and Sundays, not only Sundays. Phone 03-6447-1710.

Name: Isehiro Kyobashi Honten
Hours: Lunch 11:30–14:00; dinner 17:00–21:00 (Saturday dinner only, to 20:30); closed Sundays and holidays
Address (JA): 東京都中央区京橋1-4-9
Notes: Grilling since 1921; Tabelog Yakitori EAST 100 2025 (3.67). Cheap weekday lunch yakitori-don from ¥1,600. Closed Sundays and holidays. Update: Moved in October 2020 to the building across the street (same address now). Dinner opens 16:30 per Time Out, 17:00 per Gurunavi. Phone 03-3281-5864.

Name: Shutei Tanaka
Hours: 17:30–21:30 (Michelin lists every day); closed days not confirmed
Address (JA): 東京都墨田区墨田3-25-7
Notes: Two brothers run a salt-forward set course that ends with an oyakodon; new Michelin Bib Gourmand for 2026. Mid-price. Update: Formerly 鳥田中 (moved here 2017); two seatings since 2023 as 酒亭田中. Online booking via omakase.in/TableCheck; phone 03-3617-6615.

Name: Fuunji
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区代々木二丁目
Notes: Tokyo's benchmark thick chicken-and-fish tsukemen; Tabelog 3.76, Ramen 100 2025. Buy a ticket from the machine; queues at peak times.

Name: Rokurinsha
Hours: 7:30–10:00 (last order 9:30, morning menu); 10:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); follows the complex's closed days
Address (JA): 東京都千代田区丸の内1-9-1 東京駅一番街 B1F 東京ラーメンストリート内
Notes: Famous rich tsukemen in the Tokyo Station Ramen Street basement; Tabelog 3.77, Ramen 100 2025. Go early morning or mid-afternoon to avoid the line. Update: Opens at 7:30 for a morning service, which suits the Info line's early-morning tip. Phone 03-3286-0166.

Name: Raa Menya Shima
Hours: Mon–Fri 8:45–14:30 per Tabelog; closed Saturdays, Sundays and holidays
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区本町3-41-12
Notes: Tabelog 4.07 and Tabelog Award 2026 Bronze; one of Tokyo's highest-rated ramen shops. Expect a very long wait. Update: Address is in Shibuya ward (Honmachi), 363 m from Nishi-Shinjuku-Gochome Station. Reservations reportedly go through TableCheck, released the day before.

Name: Sosakumenkobo Nakiryu
Hours: 11:30–15:00 (and 18:00–21:00 per one source); closed Tuesdays
Address (JA): 東京都豊島区南大塚2-34-4 SKY南大塚1F
Notes: Tantanmen with sesame paste, chili oil and black vinegar; formerly Michelin-starred, now Bib Gourmand. Numbered tickets handed out from 8am; closed Tuesdays. Update: Sources disagree on evening service (one lists 18:00–21:00, another only 11:00–15:30). Phone 03-6304-1811.

Name: Mendokoro Honda
Hours: 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–21:30 (Retty: evening to 20:00); closed Wednesdays
Address (JA): 東京都千代田区神田花岡町1-19
Notes: Tabelog 3.81, Ramen 100 2025; 40m from Akihabara Station. Update: Under the railway arches by Akihabara Station; the shop moved here from Higashi-Jujo. Phone 070-7793-3979.

Name: Ginza Haru Chan Ramen
Address (JA): 東京都中央区銀座3-11-6
Notes: New Michelin Bib Gourmand for 2026; clear, salty pork broth with dried fish. Small shop, so expect lunch lines. Update: Michelin says it serves continuously through the day. Building name and hours not found.

Name: Tempura Kondo
Hours: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 13:30); dinner 17:00–20:30; closed Sundays (and Mondays that are holidays)
Address (JA): 東京都中央区銀座5-5-13 坂口ビル9F
Notes: Two Michelin stars (2026), famous for vegetable tempura. Lunch ¥10–15k, dinner ¥20–30k. Book about a month ahead, often through a hotel concierge. Update: Phone 03-5568-0923. Hours are from Ikyu (third party).

Name: Kyobashi Tempura Fukamachi
Hours: Closed Mondays (Hitosara); times not retrieved
Address (JA): 東京都中央区京橋2-5-2 A・M京橋ビル1F
Notes: Seasonal omakase, frying vegetables and seafood at different temperatures; Michelin 1 star (2026), Tabelog Tempura 100 2025. Lunch (about ¥10–15k) is the better value.

Name: Mikawa Zezankyo
Hours: Lunch 11:30–13:30; dinner from 17:00 (last order 19:30); closed Wednesdays (2022 listing)
Address (JA): 東京都江東区福住1-3-1
Notes: Edomae tempura from veteran chef Tetsuya Saotome (founded 1976); Tabelog Tempura 100 2025. Get the kakiage with rice. Update: Address is 8 min on foot from Monzen-Nakacho Station. Phone 03-3643-8383. The hours listing dates from June 2022.

Name: Tempura Shinjuku Tsunahachi
Address (JA): ~東京都新宿区新宿三丁目
Notes: Long-running counter tempura; lunch sets with rice, pickles and clam miso soup are a good value. Multi-branch, so visit the Shinjuku flagship. Update: The official store page said the flagship was temporarily closed for rebuilding, with an annex open instead. The page may be old, so the current status is unconfirmed.

Name: Kaneko Hannosuke
Address (JA): ~東京都中央区日本橋室町一丁目
Notes: Cult tendon of shrimp, squid kakiage and nori at about ¥1,400. Lines up to 90+ minutes; the Nihonbashi original is the one to visit.

Name: Tensuke
Address (JA): ~東京都杉並区高円寺北三丁目
Notes: Michelin Bib Gourmand 2026; the signature is a tempura egg over rice, served with a showy egg-cracking routine. Cheap; lunch queues.

Name: Dote no Iseya
Address (JA): ~東京都台東区日本堤一丁目
Notes: Tendon shop founded 1889, with I/Ro/Ha grades (¥2,300–3,300); go for Ro or Ha. Long weekend queues, so go early on a weekday.

Name: Nihao
Address (JA): ~東京都大田区蒲田四丁目
Notes: Inventor of hanetsuki (winged) gyoza (1983); Tabelog Dumplings 100. Open daily 11:00–24:00, cash only; 3 minutes from JR Kamata.

Name: Okei
Address (JA): ~東京都千代田区富士見二丁目
Notes: Gyoza specialist since 1954; past Bib Gourmand, Dumplings 100 2024. Dinner on weekdays plus Saturday lunch; no reservations, cash only.

Name: Kameido Gyoza Honten
Address (JA): ~東京都江東区亀戸五丁目
Notes: Old-school 1953 shop with almost only gyoza and beer on the menu; Dumplings 100 2024. Fast turnover; closed Tuesdays.

Name: Asia Kappou Rengetsu
Address (JA): ~東京都港区南青山一丁目
Notes: Handmade Japanese-Chinese gyoza, both pan-fried pork and boiled lamb; Dumplings 100 2024 (#13). Often crowded.

Name: Harajuku Gyozaro
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区神宮前六丁目
Notes: Famously cheap fried or steamed gyoza at a counter; an easy stop while shopping.

Name: Monja Kondo Honten
Address (JA): ~東京都中央区月島三丁目
Notes: Said to have served monja since just after WWII; half portions let you try several. Tabelog 3.49.

Name: Tsukishima Monja Moheji Honten
Hours: Weekdays lunch 10:45-15:00, dinner 17:00-23:00; Sat, Sun, holidays 10:30-23:00
Address (JA): ~東京都中央区月島一丁目
Notes: Run by a seafood wholesaler: mentaiko-mochi and squid-ink monja; counter grills suit solo diners. Tabelog 3.56. Update: 4 min walk from Tsukishima Station; no address in results. Location approximate: pinned near 月島 station until the shop is found.

Name: Hantei
Hours: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:15); dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Mondays (Tuesday if Monday is a holiday); on Sundays it may close early when ingredients run out
Address (JA): 東京都文京区根津2-12-15
Notes: Set kushiage in a 100+ year-old wooden house that is a registered cultural property; lunch 8 skewers ~¥3,600, dinner 12 ~¥5,500. Reserve via TableCheck; closed Mondays.

Name: Onigiri Bongo
Address (JA): 東京都豊島区北大塚2-27-5
Notes: Since 1960; 50+ fillings in loosely packed onigiri made to order. Arrive 30+ minutes before opening; closed Sundays. Update: Time Out lists 9:00-21:00, closed Sundays, but other sources conflict; hours unverified.

Name: Onigiri Asakusa Yadoroku
Hours: Lunch from 11:30 and dinner from 17:00, until the rice runs out; sources conflict on closed days (Sun night, Tue, Wed)
Address (JA): 東京都台東区浅草3-9-10
Notes: Tokyo's oldest onigiri shop (1954), with hagama-cooked Koshihikari rice; Michelin Bib Gourmand. Closed Sundays; split lunch and dinner hours.

Name: Onigiri Yamataro
Hours: 11:00-15:00 and 16:45-18:30 (Sat, Sun evening to 20:00); irregular days off, check Instagram @yamataro_onigiri
Address (JA): 東京都豊島区雑司が谷2-10-7
Notes: Bongo-trained chef; generous two-filling onigiri with signature tonjiru (pork miso soup). Lunch only; check Instagram for days off.

Name: Onigiri Togoshiya
Hours: Mon-Sat 11:00-21:00, Sun 10:00-21:00 (Autoreserve; Time Out differs on Saturday)
Address (JA): 東京都品川区戸越2-5-3
Notes: Tsuyahime rice, 40+ made-to-order fillings, and signature karaage. Pair with a walk down the Togoshi Ginza shopping street.

Name: Tamahide
Hours: Lunch 11:15-13:45 (oyakodon orders 11:30-13:00); dinner 17:00-21:30 (last order 20:30)
Address (JA): 東京都中央区日本橋人形町1-17-10
Notes: Founded 1760 and credited with inventing oyakodon; reopened Nov 2025 after a renovation. The original oyakodon (¥2,800) uses Tokyo shamo chicken. Lunch is 11:30–13:30 only.

Name: Koharuken
Hours: 11:00-14:00, 17:00-20:00; closed Sundays and holidays, Saturday afternoon uncertain
Address (JA): 東京都中央区日本橋人形町1-7-9
Notes: Yoshoku house from 1912 serving its original katsudon with demi-glace (¥1,300). Weekdays only; 2 minutes from Tamahide.

Name: Nihonbashi Kaisendon Tsujihan
Hours: 11:00-21:00 (last order 20:30); irregular holidays
Address (JA): 東京都中央区日本橋3-1-15 久栄ビル1F
Notes: Piled seafood bowl; save some for the sea-bream broth to finish it as ochazuke. Waits up to 2 hours, so go late afternoon.

Name: Komefuku
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区恵比寿西1-4-2 川田ビルB1F
Notes: Rice-variety tasting restaurant: about 30 varieties a year, five at a time, each donabe-cooked to order. English menu; 3 minutes from JR Ebisu. Top pick for regional rices.

Name: AKOMEYA Shokudo Kagurazaka
Address (JA): ~東京都新宿区矢来町
Notes: A rice retailer's restaurant cooking rice from around Japan in iron hagama, with regional set meals. Buy the same rice in the shop.

Name: Salon Ginza Sabou
Address (JA): 東京都中央区銀座5-2-1 東急プラザ銀座B2F
Notes: Prize-winning Yukihotaka Koshihikari cooked in Iga-ware donabe; build-your-own teishoku.

Name: Ikushika
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区宇田川町15-1 渋谷PARCO B1
Notes: Affordable sets with Fukushima rice cooked in donabe and held in wooden ohitsu; free refills.

Name: Kamameshi Haru Asakusa Honten
Hours: 11:00-21:00 (last order 20:00); generally closed Wednesdays, varies by month; weekday food orders paused 14:30-16:00 from 1 June 2026
Address (JA): 東京都台東区浅草1-14-9
Notes: Iron-pot kamameshi since 1926 (crab, shrimp, scallop); about 20 minutes per pot. English menu; near Senso-ji.

Name: Fukagawajuku
Hours: Weekdays 11:30-15:00 and 17:00-21:00; weekends and holidays 11:30-17:00 (last orders about 30 min earlier)
Address (JA): 東京都江東区三好1-6-7
Notes: Tokyo clam rice served both ways: bukkake (broth over rice) and takikomi (cooked in). Pair with Tomioka Hachimangu or Mikawa Zezankyo. Update: The honten is by Kiyosumi-Shirakawa, not Monzen-Nakacho; the Monzen-Nakacho branch (Tomioka Hachiman-ten) is dinner-only 17:00-23:00 Mon-Sat.

Name: Choju-an Kyosho
Hours: 11:30-14:30 (Mon-Sat and holidays), 17:30-20:00 (Mon-Sat, until soba sells out); closed Sundays
Address (JA): 東京都江東区平野1-7-2
Notes: Soba shop whose Fukagawa set combines soba, mini clam rice and seasonal tempura. Update: Address comes from a 2015 TV listing.

Name: Tonkatsu Narikura
Hours: Lunch 11:00-14:00, dinner 17:30-20:00, fully reservation-only; irregular days off
Address (JA): 東京都杉並区成田東4-33-9
Notes: Pale "blonde" low-temperature-fried cutlets; Tabelog 4.29, Award 2026 Bronze. Reservation only, served in fixed seatings, so be on time. About ¥6,500–8,000.

Name: Tonkatsu Tonki
Hours: 16:00-21:30 (last order 21:00); closed Tuesdays
Address (JA): 東京都目黒区下目黒1-1-2
Notes: Since 1939; long counter around an open kitchen. Rosu or hire set ¥2,300, and the tonjiru is a highlight. No reservations; open 4–9pm; closed Tuesdays.

Name: Tonkatsu Marugo
Address (JA): ~東京都千代田区外神田一丁目
Notes: Thick, tender pork in a crunchy crust; Tabelog 3.74, Tonkatsu 100 2026. Good value (¥1–2k).

Name: Tonkatsu Nanaido
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区神宮前3-42-11 ローザビアンカ1F
Notes: Tokyo's #2 tonkatsu by Tabelog score (3.98). It has relocated, so check the current address. Update: Planner says it relocated; this address may be the old one and no move was found.

Name: Butagumi
Address (JA): ~東京都港区六本木七丁目
Notes: Menu of branded pork breeds at different prices; Tonkatsu 100 2026. Closed Mondays and the 2nd and 4th Tuesday.

Name: Tonkatsu Maisen Aoyama Honten
Hours: 11:00-22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Jan 1-2
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区神宮前4-8-5
Notes: Chain flagship and the classic reference point; known for katsu sando to take away. Easy to get into, but rated lower than the specialists.

Name: Gyukatsu Motomura
Hours: 11:00-22:00 daily (last order 22:00)
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区渋谷3-18-10 大野ビル2号館 B1F
Notes: Chain, but the reference point: sear rare breaded beef on a mini grill at your table. Tabelog only 3.26; pick whichever branch has the shortest line. Update: Tabelog reviews hint at irregular holidays.

Name: Gyukatsu Aona
Hours: 11:00–22:30 daily (L.O. 22:00); sources differ (some say to 23:00)
Address (JA): 東京都台東区上野6-5-7 JUNビル1階
Notes: Very rare wagyu gyukatsu in 200g portions with free rice refills; unlike most, it takes reservations. Update: Listed as Okachimachi main branch (御徒町本店); address came from a Korean/Thai listing page.

Name: Asakusa Gyukatsu
Address (JA): ~東京都台東区雷門二丁目
Notes: Crisp beef cutlet at mid-range prices (Tabelog 3.45); handy near Senso-ji.

Name: Kabuto
Hours: 17:00–22:00; closed Thursdays, Sundays and holidays
Address (JA): 東京都豊島区池袋2-53-2
Notes: Tabelog's top unagi in Tokyo (4.43, Award 2026 Silver): a counter course of eel skewers using every part of the eel. Booking months out; not the Omoide Yokocho stall. Update: Retty page is an Ikebukuro west-side eel skewer shop; reviews mention reservation-only seatings.

Name: Unagi Uomasa
Address (JA): ~東京都葛飾区東四つ木四丁目
Notes: Tabelog 4.29, Award 2026 Silver: a daily eel course including liver and kurikara-yaki. Reserve only via its official site; no children under 7.

Name: Nodaiwa
Address (JA): 東京都港区東麻布1-5-4
Notes: Edo-era house, Kanto style (steamed then grilled); Michelin 1 star; its 97-year-old chef won the Michelin Mentor Award 2026. Try the shirayaki (unsauced) with caviar.

Name: Unagi Obana
Address (JA): ~東京都荒川区南千住五丁目
Notes: Meiji-era Edo-style unagi-ya with a big tatami room; unaju ¥4–5.3k; Tabelog 3.77. Grilled to order (30+ minute wait); closed Mondays.

Name: Yaesu Unagi Hashimoto
Hours: Weekdays 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–20:30; Sat 11:30–15:00; holidays 11:00–15:00; closed Sundays
Address (JA): 東京都中央区八重洲1-5-10
Notes: Counter seats where you watch the eel get cut, steamed and grilled; Tabelog 3.94, Michelin Bib Gourmand. Near Tokyo Station.

Name: Watabe
Hours: 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:00); closed Wednesdays and Thursdays, Dec 31–Jan 4; extra closures (e.g. Tuesdays in Nov, Dec, Feb, Jan) posted on their calendar
Address (JA): 東京都文京区小石川1-9-14
Notes: The Enma-ju puts sauced and unsauced eel in one box; Tabelog 4.06, Michelin Bib Gourmand. Update: Closed Wed and Thu; some Tuesdays also closed in winter. Reservations by TableCheck, phone or Tabelog; phone hard to get through.

Name: Akasaka Raimon
Address (JA): ~東京都港区赤坂五丁目
Notes: The splurge: Tabelog 4.54, Award 2026 Gold; about ¥15–20k. Expect very hard reservations. Update: Search found no yakiniku shop by this name; spelling may differ. Location approximate: pinned near 赤坂 station until the shop is found.

Name: Yoroniku
Hours: 17:00–24:00 (day-of-week pattern unknown)
Address (JA): 東京都港区南青山6-6-22 ルナロッサ地下1階
Notes: Prix-fixe courses with slim chateaubriand and wagyu with truffle, dishes rivals later copied; Time Out calls it essential. Tabelog 3.79 (the Ebisu branch scores 4.25). About ¥10–15k.

Name: Yakiniku Jumbo Shirokane
Hours: Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); Sat, Sun, holidays 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–23:00; closed Dec 31–Jan 2
Address (JA): 東京都港区白金3-1-1 第一麻布ビル1F
Notes: Order the nohara-yaki (thin, lightly seared sirloin), zabuton, misuji and garlic rice; Yakiniku 100 2025. Book via TableCheck.

Name: Yakiniku Ushigoro
Address (JA): ~東京都中央区銀座一丁目
Notes: Polished wagyu yakiniku (Tabelog 100 2026); easier to book than the top tier. About ¥8–15k.

Name: Yakiniku Tetsu
Address (JA): ~東京都新宿区西新宿一丁目
Notes: Good-value wagyu yakiniku (Tabelog 100 2026): dinner ¥6–8k, lunch ¥3–4k. Update: Search found nothing for this shop. Location approximate: pinned near 新宿 station until the shop is found.

Name: Ningyocho Imahan Honten
Address (JA): ~東京都中央区日本橋人形町二丁目
Notes: Century-old beef house dating back to gyu-nabe, the precursor to sukiyaki; classic sukiyaki, Hot Pot 100 2026. Lunch about ¥5–6k is good value. Update: Reservations by TableCheck (tablecheck.com/shops/imahanhonten/reserve), phone 03-3666-7006. Site lists a November/December closed-days notice; check it.

Name: Sukiyaki Kappou Hiyama
Address (JA): ~東京都中央区日本橋人形町二丁目
Notes: Sukiyaki with a butcher attached (unverified); Tabelog 3.70, Hot Pot 100 2026.

Name: Chinya
Hours: Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 16:30–21:30; Sat, Sun, holidays 11:00–21:30 (last order 20:00); regular closed days not listed
Address (JA): 東京都台東区花川戸2-16-1
Notes: Long-running Asakusa sukiyaki house; Hot Pot 100 2026. Lunch from about ¥3,000.

Name: subin
Address (JA): ~東京都中央区銀座五丁目
Notes: Tokyo's top-rated hot-pot restaurant on Tabelog (4.15+), Award 2026 Bronze. A big splurge; hard to book. Update: Search found nothing for this shop. Location approximate: pinned near 銀座 station until the shop is found.

Name: Zakuro
Address (JA): ~東京都中央区銀座四丁目
Notes: Long-standing shabu-shabu and sukiyaki house; lunch about ¥2–3k is a good value.

Name: Imafuku
Address (JA): 東京都港区白金1-12-19
Notes: Upscale wagyu shabu-shabu and sukiyaki; Hot Pot 100 2024. About ¥15–20k. Update: Tabelog lists sukiyaki/shabu-shabu at this address; hours blank there (another site shows 17:00-23:00 at the same address without naming the shop).

Name: Sembikiya Sohonten
Hours: Fruit parlor (2nd floor) hours not on the page; shop 10:00–18:00 daily
Address (JA): 東京都中央区日本橋室町2-1-2 日本橋三井タワー1F
Notes: Japan's premium fruit house since 1834; sit at the 2nd-floor counter to watch parfaits cut by hand. Strawberry season is just starting in mid-December. Reserve via TableCheck. Update: Reservations via sembikiya.take-eats.jp (not TableCheck); parlor phone 03-3241-1630.

Name: Takano Fruit Parlour
Hours: 11:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); temporarily 11:00–20:00 (last order 19:30) until further notice; closed days not listed
Address (JA): 東京都新宿区新宿3-26-11 5F
Notes: Classic fruit parlor on the 5th floor of Shinjuku Takano, plus a parfait counter on B2. About ¥2,000; 5 minutes from Shinjuku Station.

Name: Shiseido Parlour Ginza

Notes: Eat-in lunch sets (limited daily) plus boxed takeaway; the easiest option near the station. Update: Official site puts the honten at the Higashimuki arcade entrance by Kintetsu-Nara. Eat-in lunch sets not confirmed.

Name: Izasa Nakatani Honpo
Hours: 1F takeaway 10:00-17:00; 2F restaurant (ゐざさ茶屋) 11:00-17:00, LO 16:00. Closed on listed dates (November: 10, 16, 24, 30)
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市春日野町16 東大寺門前夢風ひろば内
Notes: Takeaway on the 1st floor; restaurant upstairs (11:00–17:00) with kakinoha-zushi and Miwa somen, and views of Todaiji. Arrive early. Update: Specific closed dates are posted monthly on the shop page.

Name: Hiraso
Hours: Main building shop 10:00-20:30; annex dining 11:30-20:00 (LO 20:00); closed Mondays
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市今御門町30-1
Notes: One of the oldest makers (~150 years, from Yoshino); renovated restaurant also serves chagayu and tempura. Offers kakinoha-zushi-making workshops. Update: Lunch booking only taken for groups of 10+. Hours vary by season.

Name: Kamameshi Shizuka
Hours: Mon, Wed-Fri 11:00-15:00; Sat, Sun 11:00-16:00; closed Tuesdays
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市登大路町59-11
Notes: 60+ years; each pot cooked to order over an open flame, giving a crispy okoge crust. Closed Tuesdays.

Name: Tou no Chaya
Hours: 11:30-15:30 (may close around 14:00 if ingredients run out); dinner by reservation only (kaiseki); closed Tuesdays
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市南城戸町18
Notes: Nara's tea-rice porridge specialist; chagayu bento or kaiseki. Reserve ahead. Update: Lunch: advance booking requested; dinner is reservation-only kaiseki.

Name: Sabo Non-non
Hours: Tue-Fri 11:30-14:00; Sat, Sun 11:00-14:00; closed Mondays (open if a holiday)
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市西新屋町43 奈良オリエント館内
Notes: Chagayu set in the tatami room of a ~180-year-old machiya. Update: Tabelog 'Sabou Nonnon' (Naramachi, near Kyobate). Machiya age not confirmed.

Name: Ajitei Yamazakiya
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市東向南町5
Notes: Restaurant of a Narazuke pickle maker: hojicha chagayu set with pickles, plus kakinoha-zushi. Update: Best match: Narazuke maker Yamazakiya Honten in Higashimuki. The restaurant name 'Ajitei' was not confirmed.

Name: Menya Bibiri
Hours: Daily 11:00-15:00 and 18:00-21:00; closed dinner on the last day of each month and Jan 1
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市七条町165-1
Notes: Casual counter; fish-and-chicken soba and mazesoba; Ramen WEST 100 2025 (#13). Update: Address is in Shichijo-cho; Kujo Station is 625 m away.

Name: Yakitori Mochizuki
Hours: 17:30-22:30 daily; irregular closed days
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市杉ケ町32-14
Notes: Set course over binchotan with whole birds butchered in-house; Michelin-listed 2026, Yakitori WEST 100 (#20). Update: Neighbourhood is 杉ケ町 (Sugigamachi), not Surugamachi. Reservation only; Tabelog bookings limited to 2 people.

Name: Tempura Hattori
Hours: 17:00-21:00; closed Wednesdays
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市大森町23-1
Notes: Omakase tempura by a ryotei-trained chef, ending with tencha; Michelin-listed 2026. Cash only. Update: Online booking only. Cash-only not verified.

Name: Seikoudoku
Hours: Mon-Thu 11:00-14:30 (LO 14:30); closed Fri, Sat, Sun
Address (JA): 京都府宇治市宇治池森20-1
Notes: Homemade flat noodles in soupless sesame-miso tantanmen; Ramen WEST 100 2025 (#19). Expect a line. Update: Open Monday-Thursday only. About 15 min walk from JR Uji. Booking opens at midnight the day before; walk-ins get an estimated time.

Name: Yubadon Naokichi
Hours: 11:00-18:00 daily per Tabelog (the planner's note says closed Tuesdays; not confirmed)
Address (JA): 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町湯本696
Notes: Yuba-don: housemade yuba cooked with egg in a clay pot over rice. 11:00–18:00, closed Tuesdays; 5 minutes from the station. Update: Tabelog lists no closed day; the line says closed Tuesdays.

Name: Tamura Ginkatsutei
Hours: Mon, Thu-Sun 11:00-14:30 and 17:00-19:00; Tue 11:00-14:30; closed Wednesdays
Address (JA): 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町強羅1300-739
Notes: Hakone's famous tofu katsu-ni (tofu with pork and egg, simmered in a clay pot), since 1973. 1 minute from Gora Station; queues common. Update: Honten is 98 m from Gora Station. Official site has a certificate error; hours from Tabelog.
